commitments.directionality_rationale: Tone *31 (Tone 1) is preserved in Achang and Xiandao as 31; Rangoon Burmese shifted it to 55.
Tone *55 (Tone 2) is preserved in Achang and Xiandao as 55; Rangoon Burmese shifted it to 22.
Checked tone *4 in stopped syllables is preserved in Rangoon; merged into 55 in Achang and Xiandao.
Medial glide *-w- is preserved in Rangoon Burmese and outgroups (Atsi, Bola, Lashi, Maru v); monophthongized/lost in Achang and Xiandao.
Final glottal stop *-ʔ preserved across all children.
Checked tone *4 in 2-way Xiandao-Rangoon cognates; Xiandao merged into 55, Rangoon preserves short checked tone 4.
Open vowel *a is preserved in Achang and Xiandao as a; backed to ɑ in Rangoon Burmese.
Coda *-m is preserved in Achang, Xiandao, and outgroups (Atsi, Lashi); lost or nasalized in Rangoon Burmese.
Coda *-n is preserved in Achang, Xiandao, and outgroups (Atsi, Lashi, Bola); lost or nasalized in Rangoon Burmese.
Coda *-ŋ is preserved in Achang, Xiandao, and outgroups (Atsi, Lashi, Bola, Maru); lost or nasalized in Rangoon Burmese.
Medial glide *-j- is preserved in Rangoon and outgroups (Atsi, Bola, Lashi, Maru); palatalized/lost in Achang and Xiandao.
Tone *31 in 2-way Xiandao-Rangoon cognates; Xiandao preserves 31, Rangoon shifted to 55.
Vowel *a before nasal coda; preserved as a in Achang and Xiandao, nasalized to ɑ̃ in Rangoon.
Diphthong *au is preserved in Achang, Xiandao, and outgroups (Atsi, Bola); monophthongized to o in Rangoon.
Final *-p is preserved in Achang, Xiandao, and outgroups (Atsi, Lashi); debuccalized to glottal stop ʔ in Rangoon.
Final *-ŋ is preserved in Achang and outgroups (Bola, Maru, Atsi, Lashi); lost in Xiandao and Rangoon.
Initial velar nasal *ŋ preserved across all children.
Vowel *a in 2-way Xiandao-Rangoon cognates; Xiandao preserves a, Rangoon backed to ɑ.
Final *-p in 2-way Xiandao-Rangoon cognates; Xiandao preserves p, Rangoon debuccalized to ʔ.
Tone *31 in 2-way Xiandao-Rangoon cognates; Xiandao preserves 31, Rangoon shifted to 53.
Back vowel *ɔ in 2-way Xiandao-Rangoon cognates; Xiandao preserves ɔ, Rangoon unrounded to ɑ.
Secondary non-etymological glottal stop insertion in Xiandao; not present in proto-language.
Final *-ʔ in 2-way Xiandao-Rangoon cognates; preserved in both daughters.
Tone *55 in 2-way Xiandao-Rangoon cognates; Xiandao preserves 55, Rangoon shifted to 22.
Vowel *a before nasal coda in 2-way/3-way cognates; Achang/Xiandao preserve a, Rangoon shows nasal vowel ĩ.
Front vowel *e preserved in Achang; backed to ɔ in Xiandao and ɑ in Rangoon.
High front vowel *i preserved in Achang and Xiandao; lowered to e in Rangoon.
Alveolar nasal *n preserved across all children.
Back vowel *o preserved in Achang and Xiandao; unrounded to ɑ in Rangoon.
Alveolar stop *t preserved across all children.
Initial *ts affricate preserved in Achang and outgroups; shifted to m in Xiandao and Rangoon.
Aspirated velar stop *kʰ preserved in Rangoon and outgroups; spirantized to x in Achang and Xiandao.
Tone *31 in compound morphemes; Xiandao preserves 31, Achang shifted to 35, Rangoon to 53.
Tone *53 (Tone 3) preserved in Rangoon; shifted to 35 in Achang and Xiandao.
Initial *m before medial *j preserved in Rangoon and outgroups; palatalized to ȵ in Achang and ɲ in Xiandao.
Back vowel *ɔ preserved in Achang and Xiandao; unrounded to ɑ in Rangoon.
Back vowel *ɔ before stop/glottal preserved in Achang and Xiandao; fronted to ɛ in Rangoon.
Initial retroflex fricative *ʐ preserved in Achang and Xiandao; deleted in Rangoon.
Initial glide *j preserved in Rangoon and outgroups; hardened to ʐ in Achang and Xiandao.
High tone *55 preserved across all children.

request.summary: Reconstruction of Proto-Burmic from Achang (Longchuan), Xiandao, and Rangoon Burmese. Proto-Burmic preserves the tonal categories (*31 / Tone 1, *55 / Tone 2, *53 / Tone 3, and checked *4 in stopped syllables), conserved initials (stops *t, *kʰ, nasals *m, *n, *ŋ, glides *j, *w, and sibilants/affricates *ts, *ʐ), oral and nasal codas (*-p, *-ʔ, *-m, *-n, *-ŋ), and vowels (*a, *i, *e, *o, *ɔ, *au). Rangoon Burmese exhibits regular nasalization/coda loss, debuccalization of final *-p to -ʔ, and tone shifts (*31 > 55, *55 > 22); Achang and Xiandao exhibit spirantization of *kʰ > x, glide hardening *j- > ʐ-, and loss/monophthongization of medial *-w-.
